# Cohort summary

## Density

### Age

```{r}
df_both <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV", Timepoint %in% c("Baseline", "Follow-up")) %>%
  mutate(
    Age_use = dplyr::case_when(
      Timepoint == "Baseline"  ~ `Age (baseline)`,
      Timepoint == "Follow-up" ~ `Age (follow-up)`,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Age_use), !is.na(Subcategory)) %>%
  group_by(Subcategory) %>%
  mutate(
    Subcategory = fct_reorder(Subcategory, Age_use, .fun = median, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

density_age <- ggplot(df_both, aes(x = Age_use, y = Subcategory, fill = Timepoint)) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    alpha = 0.5,
    scale = 1.2,
    rel_min_height = 0.01,
    color = "grey20",
    size = 0.3,
    quantile_lines = TRUE, 
    quantiles = 0.5,
    vline_linetype = "solid",
    vline_color   = "black",
    vline_size    = 0.4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "Subcategory",
    title = "Age density per Subcategory (HIV, Baseline vs Follow-up)",
    subtitle = "Fill color = timepoint; vertical line = median"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Baseline" = "#1f78b4", "Follow-up" = "#33a02c")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

density_age

ggsave("../plots/pdf/density/age_density_ridges_baseline_followup.pdf", width = 14, height = 7)
ggsave("../plots/png/density/age_density_ridges_baseline_followup.pdf", width = 14, height = 7)
```

## Sankey plot

Creating a Sankey plot starting with group by subcategory, then going to CD4/CD8, then ART, then backbone 2, then CD4/CD8 again at follow-up.

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Define categorical levels
# -----------------------------
cd4cd8_levels <- c("Normal", "Low", "Very Low")
subcategory_levels <- c("Elite Controller", "More preserved immunity",
                        "Severely impaired immunity", "Primary HIV Infection")
art_levels <- c("Untreated", "Other", "INSTI", "NNRTI")
backbone_levels <- c("Untreated", "Other", "Abacavir", "Tenofovir")

# -----------------------------
# Define color palettes
# -----------------------------
stratum_colors <- c(
  # Subcategory
  "Elite Controller" = "#1b9e77",
  "More preserved immunity" = "#d95f02",
  "Severely impaired immunity" = "#7570b3",
  "Primary HIV Infection" = "#e7298a",
  # CD4/CD8 status
  "Normal" = "#66c2a5",
  "Low" = "#fc8d62",
  "Very Low" = "#8da0cb",
  # ART
  "INSTI" = "#e78ac3",
  "NNRTI" = "#a6d854",
  "Other" = "#ffd92f",
  "Untreated" = "#e5c494",
  # Backbone
  "Abacavir" = "#b3b3b3",
  "Tenofovir" = "#80b1d3"
)

# -----------------------------
# Prepare data
# -----------------------------
plot_data <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    # --- ART grouping ---
    ART_grouped = case_when(
      Subcategory == "Elite Controller" ~ "Untreated",
      ART == "INSTI" ~ "INSTI",
      ART == "NNRTI" ~ "NNRTI",
      TRUE ~ "Other"  # everyone else is Other
    ),

    # --- Backbone grouping ---
    Backbone_grouped = case_when(
      Subcategory == "Elite Controller" ~ "Untreated",
      str_detect(tolower(`Backbone 2`), "abacavir") ~ "Abacavir",
      str_detect(tolower(`Backbone 2`), "tenofovir") ~ "Tenofovir",
      TRUE ~ "Other"  # all non-EC or unrecognized backbones = Other
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    ID, Subcategory,
    `CD4/CD8 status (baseline)`, ART_grouped,
    Backbone_grouped, `CD4/CD8 status (follow-up)`
  ) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Subcategory = factor(Subcategory, levels = subcategory_levels),
    ART_grouped = factor(ART_grouped, levels = art_levels),
    Backbone_grouped = factor(Backbone_grouped, levels = backbone_levels),
    `CD4/CD8 status (baseline)` = factor(`CD4/CD8 status (baseline)`, levels = cd4cd8_levels),
    `CD4/CD8 status (follow-up)` = factor(`CD4/CD8 status (follow-up)`, levels = cd4cd8_levels)
  )

# -----------------------------
# Sankey / Alluvial plot
# -----------------------------
sankey_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(axis1 = Subcategory,
      axis2 = `CD4/CD8 status (baseline)`,
      axis3 = ART_grouped,
      axis4 = Backbone_grouped,
      axis5 = `CD4/CD8 status (follow-up)`,
      y = n)
) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Subcategory), width = 1/12, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_stratum(aes(fill = after_stat(stratum)), width = 1/12) +
  geom_label(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(label = paste0(after_stat(stratum), "\n(n=", after_stat(count), ")")),
    size = 3,
    lineheight = 0.9,
    fill = "black",
    color = "white",
    label.size = NA
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = stratum_colors, name = "Group") +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("Subcategory", "CD4/CD8 status (baseline)",
               "ART", "Backbone", "CD4/CD8 status (follow-up)"),
    expand = c(0.05, 0.05)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Sankey flow of HIV subcategories, CD4/CD8 status, ART, and backbones",
    subtitle = "Only Elite Controllers are untreated; all others grouped as INSTI, NNRTI, or Other",
    y = "Number of individuals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  # remove legend
  theme(legend.position = "none")

sankey_plot

ggsave("../plots/pdf/sankey/sankey_plot.pdf", width = 18, height = 8)
ggsave("../plots/png/sankey/sankey_plot.png", width = 18, height = 8)
```

## Sex

```{r}
# Summarize counts per Subcategory × Sex
sex_summary <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Sex)) %>%
  count(Subcategory, Sex)

# Stacked barplot: Subcategory on x, counts on y, fill by Sex
```

## Improvements

```{r}
# 1. Define category levels
cd4cd8_levels <- c("Very Low", "Low", "Normal")

# 2. Classify each individual's change in CD4/CD8 status
cd4cd8_class <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(Subcategory, ID,
         baseline = `CD4/CD8 status (baseline)`,
         followup = `CD4/CD8 status (follow-up)`) %>%
  filter(!is.na(baseline) & !is.na(followup)) %>%
  mutate(
    baseline = factor(baseline, levels = cd4cd8_levels),
    followup = factor(followup, levels = cd4cd8_levels),
    change   = case_when(
      as.numeric(followup) > as.numeric(baseline) ~ "Improved",
      as.numeric(followup) < as.numeric(baseline) ~ "Worsened",
      TRUE                                        ~ "Similar"
    )
  )

# 3. Summarize counts and percents per subcategory
cd4cd8_summary <- cd4cd8_class %>%
  count(Subcategory, change) %>%
  group_by(Subcategory) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1),
    label   = paste0(n, " (", percent, "%)")
  )

# 4. Stacked barplot: Subcategory on x, counts on y, fill by change
bar_improvements <- ggplot(cd4cd8_summary, aes(x = Subcategory, y = n, fill = change)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            color    = "black",
            size     = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Improved" = "#1b9e77",
               "Similar"  = "grey80",
               "Worsened" = "#d95f02")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0)),
                     name   = "Number of individuals") +
  labs(
    title = "CD4/CD8 Category Change (Baseline → Follow-up)",
    x     = "Subcategory",
    fill  = "Change"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top",
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

bar_improvements

ggsave("../plots/pdf/bar/barplot_cd4cd8_change.pdf", width = 10, height = 7)
ggsave("../plots/png/bar/barplot_cd4cd8_change.png", width = 10, height = 7)
```

```{r}
# 1. Define backbone levels (optional ordering)
backbone_levels <- c("Untreated", "Tenofovir", "Abacavir", "Other treatment")

# 2. Summarize Backbone 2 by subcategory
backbone_summary <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    `Backbone 2` = ifelse(is.na(`Backbone 2`), "Other", `Backbone 2`),
    backbone_group = factor(`Backbone 2`, levels = backbone_levels)
  ) %>%
  # If Backbone 2 is NA and not elite controller, label as "Other treatment"
  mutate(
    backbone_group = case_when(
      Subcategory == "Elite Controller" ~ "Untreated",
      is.na(`Backbone 2`)               ~ "Other treatment",
      TRUE                             ~ as.character(backbone_group)

  # If NA then Other treatment

    backbone_group = replace_na(backbone_group, "Other treatment")
```

## Treatment type

```{r}
# 1. Define factor levels
treatment_levels <- c(
  "INSTI + Other",
  "INSTI + Abacavir",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir",
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir",
  "Untreated",
  "Other + Abacavir",
  "Other + Tenofovir",
  "NNRTI + Abacavir"
)

subcategory_levels <- c(
  "Elite Controller",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Primary HIV Infection"
)

# 2. Summarize Treatment by Subcategory
treatment_summary <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    # Replace missing treatments with "Other + Other" placeholder
    Treatment = ifelse(is.na(Treatment), "Other + Other", Treatment),
    
    # Elite Controllers are always considered untreated
    Treatment = case_when(
      Subcategory == "Elite Controller" ~ "Untreated",
      TRUE ~ Treatment
    ),
    
    # Recode any treatments not in the predefined levels as "Other + Other"
    Treatment = ifelse(!Treatment %in% treatment_levels, "Other + Other", Treatment),
    
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treatment_levels),
    Subcategory = factor(Subcategory, levels = subcategory_levels)
  ) %>%
  count(Treatment, Subcategory)

# 3. Stacked barplot: Treatment on y-axis, colored by Subcategory
ggplot(treatment_summary, aes(y = Treatment, x = n, fill = Subcategory)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "black",
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Elite Controller" = "#1b9e77",
      "More preserved immunity" = "#d95f02",
      "Severely impaired immunity" = "#7570b3",
      "Primary HIV Infection" = "#e7298a"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0)),
                     name = "Number of individuals") +
  labs(
    title = "Subcategory distribution by treatment combination",
    y = "Treatment combination",
    fill = "Subcategory"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# 4. Save outputs
ggsave("../plots/pdf/bar/stacked_bar_treatment_combinations.pdf", width = 10, height = 7)
ggsave("../plots/png/bar/stacked_bar_treatment_combinations.png", width = 10, height = 7)
```

## Simplified treatment groups

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ---------------------------
# 1. Define factor levels
# ---------------------------
treatment_levels <- c(
  "INSTI + Abacavir",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir",
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir",
  "Untreated",
  "Other"
)

subcategory_levels <- c(
  "Elite Controller",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Primary HIV Infection"
)

# ---------------------------
# 2. Summarize Treatment by Subcategory
# ---------------------------
treatment_summary <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    # Start by handling missing treatments
    Treatment = if_else(is.na(Treatment), "Other", Treatment),

    # Elite Controllers are always untreated
    Treatment = if_else(
      Subcategory == "Elite Controller",
      "Untreated",
      Treatment
    ),

    # Collapse everything else not explicitly listed into "Other"
    Treatment = if_else(
      Treatment %in% treatment_levels,
      Treatment,
      "Other"
    ),

    Treatment   = factor(Treatment, levels = treatment_levels),
    Subcategory = factor(Subcategory, levels = subcategory_levels)
  ) %>%
  count(Treatment, Subcategory)

# ---------------------------
# 3. Stacked barplot
# ---------------------------
ggplot(treatment_summary, aes(y = Treatment, x = n, fill = Subcategory)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Elite Controller" = "#1b9e77",
      "More preserved immunity" = "#d95f02",
      "Severely impaired immunity" = "#7570b3",
      "Primary HIV Infection" = "#e7298a"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0)),
    name = "Number of individuals"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Subcategory distribution by treatment combination",
    y = "Treatment combination",
    fill = "Subcategory"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

# ---------------------------
# 4. Save outputs
# ---------------------------
ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/bar/stacked_bar_treatment_combinations_simple.pdf",
  width = 10, height = 7
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/bar/stacked_bar_treatment_combinations_simple.png",
  width = 10, height = 7
)

```

# Counting HIV RNA copies

```{r}
metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(ID, Subcategory, `HIV-RNA (baseline)`, `HIV-RNA (follow-up)`) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_undetectable = sum(`HIV-RNA (baseline)` < 20, na.rm = TRUE),
    followup_undetectable = sum(`HIV-RNA (follow-up)` < 20, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

# Table 1

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
library(stringr)
library(openxlsx)

# ---------------------------
# Prepare HIV data
# ---------------------------
table1_df <- metadata |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV") |>
  mutate(
    Subcategory = factor(
      Subcategory,
      levels = c(
        "Primary HIV Infection",
        "More preserved immunity",
        "Severely impaired immunity",
        "Elite Controller"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
  NNRTI = case_when(
    ART == "NNRTI" ~ "Yes",
    is.na(ART)     ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE           ~ "No"
  ),
  INSTI = case_when(
    ART == "INSTI" ~ "Yes",
    is.na(ART)     ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE           ~ "No"
  ),
  `Other ART` = case_when(
    is.na(ART)                 ~ NA_character_,
    !ART %in% c("NNRTI","INSTI") ~ "Yes",
    TRUE                        ~ "No"
  ),
  Abacavir = case_when(
    is.na(`Backbone 2`) ~ NA_character_,
    str_detect(tolower(`Backbone 2`), "abacavir") ~ "Yes",
    TRUE ~ "No"
  ),
  Tenofovir = case_when(
    is.na(`Backbone 2`) ~ NA_character_,
    str_detect(tolower(`Backbone 2`), "tenofovir") ~ "Yes",
    TRUE ~ "No"
  ),
  `Other backbone` = case_when(
    is.na(`Backbone 2`) ~ NA_character_,
    !str_detect(tolower(`Backbone 2`), "abacavir|tenofovir") ~ "Yes",
    TRUE ~ "No"
  )
) |>  mutate(
    `HIV-RNA (baseline)`  = log10(`HIV-RNA (baseline)` + 1),
    `HIV-RNA (follow-up)` = log10(`HIV-RNA (follow-up)` + 1)
  ) |>
  select(
    ID, Subcategory, Sex,
    Age_bl  = `Age (baseline)`,
    BMI_bl  = `BMI (baseline)`,
    CD4_bl  = `CD4 cell count (baseline)`,
    CD4CD8_bl = `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`,
    HIVRNA_bl = `HIV-RNA (baseline)`,

    Age_fu  = `Age (follow-up)`,
    BMI_fu  = `BMI (follow-up)`,
    CD4_fu  = `CD4 cell count (follow-up)`,
    CD4CD8_fu = `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)`,
    HIVRNA_fu = `HIV-RNA (follow-up)`,

    `Months on treatment`,
    NNRTI, INSTI, `Other ART`,
    Abacavir, Tenofovir, `Other backbone`
  ) |>
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---------------------------
# Helper test functions (FIXED)
# ---------------------------
kw <- function(df, var) {
  tryCatch(
    kruskal.test(df[[var]] ~ df$Subcategory)$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
}

fisher <- function(df, var) {
  tryCatch(
    fisher.test(table(df[[var]], df$Subcategory))$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
}

# ---------------------------
# P-values
# ---------------------------
pvals <- tibble(
  Variable = c(
    "N",
    "Female, n (%)",
    "Male, n (%)",
    "Age (baseline), median (IQR)",
    "BMI (baseline), median (IQR)",
    "CD4 count (baseline), median (IQR)",
    "CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline), median (IQR)",
    "HIV RNA (baseline, log10), median (IQR)",
    "Age (follow-up), median (IQR)",
    "BMI (follow-up), median (IQR)",
    "CD4 count (follow-up), median (IQR)",
    "CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up), median (IQR)",
    "HIV RNA (follow-up, log10), median (IQR)",
    "Months on treatment, median (IQR)",
    "NNRTI, n (%)",
    "INSTI, n (%)",
    "Other ART, n (%)",
    "Abacavir, n (%)",
    "Tenofovir, n (%)",
    "Other backbone, n (%)"
  ),
  `P-value` = c(
    NA,
    fisher(table1_df, "Sex"),
    fisher(table1_df, "Sex"),
    kw(table1_df, "Age_bl"),
    kw(table1_df, "BMI_bl"),
    kw(table1_df, "CD4_bl"),
    kw(table1_df, "CD4CD8_bl"),
    kw(table1_df, "HIVRNA_bl"),
    kw(table1_df, "Age_fu"),
    kw(table1_df, "BMI_fu"),
    kw(table1_df, "CD4_fu"),
    kw(table1_df, "CD4CD8_fu"),
    kw(table1_df, "HIVRNA_fu"),
    kw(table1_df, "Months on treatment"),
    fisher(table1_df, "NNRTI"),
    fisher(table1_df, "INSTI"),
    fisher(table1_df, "Other ART"),
    fisher(table1_df, "Abacavir"),
    fisher(table1_df, "Tenofovir"),
    fisher(table1_df, "Other backbone")
  )
)

# ---------------------------
# Summary table (FIXED NA handling)
# ---------------------------
summary_long <- table1_df |>
  group_by(Subcategory) |>
  summarise(
    Variable = pvals$Variable,
    Value = c(
      n(),
      paste0(sum(Sex == "F", na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             round(100 * mean(Sex == "F", na.rm = TRUE), 1), ")"),
      paste0(sum(Sex == "M", na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             round(100 * mean(Sex == "M", na.rm = TRUE), 1), ")"),

      paste0(median(Age_bl, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             quantile(Age_bl, .25, na.rm = TRUE), "–",

      paste0(median(BMI_bl, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             quantile(BMI_bl, .25, na.rm = TRUE), "–",

      paste0(median(CD4_bl, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             quantile(CD4_bl, .25, na.rm = TRUE), "–",

      paste0(median(CD4CD8_bl, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             quantile(CD4CD8_bl, .25, na.rm = TRUE), "–",

      paste0(median(HIVRNA_bl, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             quantile(HIVRNA_bl, .25, na.rm = TRUE), "–",
             quantile(HIVRNA_bl, .75, na.rm = TRUE), ")"),

      paste0(median(Age_fu, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             quantile(Age_fu, .25, na.rm = TRUE), "–",

      paste0(median(BMI_fu, na.rm = TRUE), " (",

      paste0(median(`Months on treatment`, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             quantile(`Months on treatment`, .25, na.rm = TRUE), "–",

      paste0(sum(NNRTI=="Yes")," (",round(100*mean(NNRTI=="Yes", na.rm=TRUE),1),")"),
      paste0(sum(INSTI=="Yes")," (",round(100*mean(INSTI=="Yes", na.rm=TRUE),1),")"),
      paste0(sum(`Other ART`=="Yes")," (",round(100*mean(`Other ART`=="Yes", na.rm=TRUE),1),")"),

      paste0(sum(`Other backbone`=="Yes")," (",round(100*mean(`Other backbone`=="Yes", na.rm=TRUE),1),")")
    ),
    .groups = "drop"

# ---------------------------
# Final table & export

summary_wide <- summary_long |>

  left_join(pvals, by = "Variable")

table1_gt <- summary_wide |>

  tab_header(
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# ---------------------------
# Helper: binary summary (FIXES THE BUG)
# ---------------------------
fmt_binary <- function(x) {
  n_yes   <- sum(x == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
  n_known <- sum(!is.na(x))

  if (n_known == 0) return("NA")

  paste0(
    n_yes,
    " (",
    round(100 * n_yes / n_known, 1),
    ")"
  )
}

# ---------------------------

      ART == "INSTI" ~ "Yes",

    Tenofovir = case_when(
      is.na(`Backbone 2`) ~ NA_character_,

    ),
```

# Cohort summary of Healthy/CVD/MET

## Age

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggridges)
library(forcats)

# ---------------------------
# Prepare age data
# ---------------------------
age_df <- metadata %>%
  bind_rows(hdba_metadata) %>%
  filter(
    (Disease == "HIV" & Timepoint == "Follow-up" & Subcategory != "Elite Controller") |
      Disease %in% c("Healthy") | Class %in% c("Cardiovascular", "Metabolic")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      Disease == "HIV"            ~ "HIV (Follow-up)",
      Disease == "Healthy"        ~ "Healthy",
      Class == "Cardiovascular" ~ "Cardiovascular",
      Class == "Metabolic"      ~ "Metabolic"
    ),
    Age_use = case_when(
      Disease == "HIV"            ~ `Age (follow-up)`,
      Disease != "HIV"            ~ Age,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Age_use), !is.na(Group)) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = fct_reorder(Group, Age_use, .fun = median, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# ---------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------
density_age <- ggplot(
  age_df,
  aes(x = Age_use, y = Group, fill = Group)
) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    alpha = 0.6,
    scale = 1.2,
    rel_min_height = 0.01,
    color = "grey20",
    size = 0.3,
    quantile_lines = TRUE,
    quantiles = 0.5,
    vline_linetype = "solid",
    vline_color = "black",
    vline_size = 0.4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Age distribution across cohorts",
    subtitle = "HIV follow-up compared with Healthy, Cardiovascular, and Metabolic cohorts"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "HIV (Follow-up)" = "#0072B2",
    "Healthy"        = "#71BF6E",
    "Cardiovascular" = "#FC8D62",
    "Metabolic"      = "#E5C494"
  )) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  theme_hiv()

density_age

# ---------------------------
# Save
# ---------------------------
ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/density/age_density_ridges_HIV_FU_vs_controls.pdf",
  plot   = density_age,
  width  = 14,
  height = 6
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/density/age_density_ridges_HIV_FU_vs_controls.png",
  plot   = density_age,
  width  = 14,
  height = 6
)
```

## Sex

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

# ---------------------------
# Prepare sex summary data
# ---------------------------
sex_df <- metadata %>%
  bind_rows(hdba_metadata) %>%
  filter(
    (Disease == "HIV" & Timepoint == "Follow-up" & Subcategory != "Elite Controller") |
      Disease %in% c("Healthy") |
      Class %in% c("Cardiovascular", "Metabolic")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      Disease == "HIV"            ~ "HIV (Follow-up)",
      Disease == "Healthy"        ~ "Healthy",
      Class == "Cardiovascular"   ~ "Cardiovascular",
      Class == "Metabolic"        ~ "Metabolic"
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(DAid, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Sex), !is.na(Group)) %>%
  count(Group, Sex) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = fct_reorder(Group, n, .fun = sum)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

sex_df <- sex_df %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "HIV (Follow-up)",
        "Healthy",
        "Cardiovascular",
        "Metabolic"
      )
    )
  )


# ---------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------
bar_sex <- ggplot(
  sex_df,
  aes(x = Group, y = n, fill = Sex)
) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "black",
    size = 5
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0)),
    name = "Number of individuals"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Sex distribution across cohorts",
    subtitle = "HIV follow-up compared with Healthy, Cardiovascular, and Metabolic cohorts",
    x = NULL,
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

bar_sex

# ---------------------------
# Save
# ---------------------------
ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/bar/stacked_bar_sex_HIV_FU_vs_controls.pdf",
  plot   = bar_sex,
  width  = 10,
  height = 6
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/bar/stacked_bar_sex_HIV_FU_vs_controls.png",
  plot   = bar_sex,
  width  = 10,
  height = 6
)
```
